name: HireBench
intro: HireBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文与 AgentWorldModel-1K 数据中的一个合成场景：HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline，对应发布 ID ats_applicant_tracking_system_4。该场景包含 10 个招聘任务及关联 SQLite 状态、MCP 工具、样例数据和逐任务验证器。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 四类任务结果, 完成奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强LLM裁判
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；10个招聘任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented LLM judge
intro_en: HireBench is not a standalone benchmark. It is the generated Agent World Model scenario HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline, released as ats_applicant_tracking_system_4 in AgentWorldModel-1K. The scenario has ten recruiting tasks and associated SQLite state, MCP tools, sample data, and task-specific verifiers.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 recruiting tasks
metric_en: Four-class task outcome, completion reward, Environment Error

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against Agent World Model arXiv:2602.10090v3 Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, Appendices A.1-A.3 and Table 15, official code commit 85e322f, and AgentWorldModel-1K data commit e9b8de6. At that data revision, gen_scenario.jsonl line 762 names HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline and maps it to ats_applicant_tracking_system_4; gen_tasks.jsonl line 520 supplies exactly ten tasks. This is one generated scenario, not a standalone benchmark or separately released leaderboard. The common AWM pipeline expands 100 domain-name seeds, filters CRUD suitability, embedding-deduplicates at cosine threshold 0.85, caps categories, generates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks, synthesizes SQLite schema and precondition-satisfying sample data, emits a minimal typed FastAPI/MCP interface, and creates before/after-state verifiers. Execution feedback repairs components for up to five iterations; the paper permits a 10% schema/data error threshold and requires 0% environment-startup error. Evaluation combines state signals and trajectory in a code-augmented LLM judge and returns Completed, Partially Completed, Agent Error, or Environment Error. The generated gen_*.jsonl artifacts are public; the original seed-name file and generation-run logs are not in the pinned public data tree.
